name: projipsa
description: A project butler that remembers context, coordinates project work, and manages delegated delivery for Codex and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: A project butler for memory and delivery.
interface.longDescription: Projipsa is a project butler for Codex and Claude Code. It onboards existing projects, keeps source-backed memory current, prepares status and next-work context, and manages explicitly delegated substantial work from discovery through verified review and handoff.
defaultPrompt: Use $projipsa to brief me on this project and route the next work.
Use $projipsa init to onboard this existing project.
Use $projipsa outsource to manage this substantial project through verified review.
